Crypto payment gateways offer a solution, but not all are built for automatic delivery and ownership control. This breakdown explains how to deploy a sovereign commerce stack using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments—infrastructure you own, not rent.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-complete. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway for digital products is a base-layer infrastructure stack that enables automatic payment verification, file delivery, and order storage without relying on third-party platforms. Unlike Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale, NOWPayments charges 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, this retains $921 more in revenue. The stack is designed for infrastructure sovereignty: you own the code, the hosting, and the data. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. Built for creators who need to operate outside the reach of restricted payment systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of four core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). Backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free), which automates payment verification and file delivery. Order storage uses Supabase or Google Sheets (free). File delivery is handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). NOWPayments integrates as the payment gateway, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. The webhook system triggers instant delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. No buyer account required. No KYC. Fully automated.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. It’s for creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software who need to collect payment in crypto. It’s also for creators who want to escape platform fees and retain full ownership of their infrastructure. If you’re selling a $97 product and making 100 sales per month, switching from Gumroad (10% fee) to NOWPayments (0.5% fee) retains $921 more in revenue. This stack is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities, not hypotheticals.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—retaining $921 more per month compared to Gumroad’s 10% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, including payment verification and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver the digital files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low transaction costs (under $0.10 per transaction). The webhook integration ensures automatic delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. Each component is free or low-cost, and the entire stack is designed for zero dependencies on third-party platforms. You own everything after deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Both stacks are deployed in 48 hours, with products loaded and end-to-end tested. For full documentation and source code, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, valued at $348 separately. Deploy your stack, load your products, and start selling globally without platform restrictions. Infrastructure sovereignty is not a workaround—it’s the foundation for owning your commerce.

This setup automatically verifies payments and delivers files without relying on restricted platforms. Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for full documentation and templates. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Test end-to-end functionality. Load your products and launch your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you in 48 hours, with products loaded and tested. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes full documentation and templates for non-developers.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, and Ethereum. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees for this infrastructure?
No. The stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Sheets. NOWPayments charges a one-time 0.5% fee per transaction. There are no subscriptions or recurring costs.
Can I scale this stack as my sales grow?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and scaling guidance. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook for handling increased traffic and transactions.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a non-custodial gateway, so payments are processed directly on-chain. If their service is unavailable, payments still confirm, and webhooks can be reconfigured to another gateway.
You own the entire infrastructure after deployment. No platform dependencies. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
